title: 第890章 实在有罪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

挪移之后，韩榆、忘忧散人、大乌鸦与黑蛟大王调整方向，悄无声息到了金霞观外十里处的一处山坳中。

两人一禽一兽，连一丝法力波动都未散逸出去，仿佛本就是这山间石缝里藏着的一块顽石，静静等候着。

金霞观的山门已经敞开，护山大阵被破开的痕迹犹在，几根断裂的阵旗耷拉在山门两侧，像是被打断了脊骨的蛇。

观内隐约可见人影晃动，那是几个穿着翠玉宫与紫云洲服饰的修士。

过不多时，天际忽然出现一朵白云法宝，自远处疾驰而来。

那白云法宝之上，隐约站着两道身影，一紫一翠，正是紫云老祖与流州老祖的模样。

白云法宝到了金霞观上空，缓缓下降。

就在距离山门不足百丈的一瞬间——

一团炽白色的火焰自韩榆肩头飞出，化作一只翼展丈许的火鸟，直扑白云法宝上的流州老祖。

流州老祖面色一变，发出一道黑色水流迎向火焰。

但那黑色水流在火焰面前连一息都没撑住，刚一接触火焰便如冰雪遇骄阳般融化。

火焰余势不减，直接撞上了白云法宝。

轰——！

白云法宝被火焰撞得剧烈摇晃，法宝表面的祥云纹路瞬间被烧灼得扭曲变形。

紧接着，忘忧散人的箫声响起。

不再是之前对战时的试探与拉扯，这一声响起的箫声，直接就是杀招。

层层音波如水银泻地，无孔不入，直扑那白云法宝而去。每一道音波都带着肉眼可见的涟漪，涟漪所过之处，空气都像是被拧成了麻花。

随着火焰与音波先后抵达，法宝之上的两道身影全力抵挡，但也只不过支撑一个呼吸，随后便开始变得透明模糊。

终于，箫声掠过，“紫云老祖”的身影从头到脚被切开，化作紫光膨胀开来，却在即将爆发的瞬间被大乌鸦的火焰裹住，燃烧殆尽。

“流州老祖”还想逃跑，身体化作一道黑光向金霞观内投去——但大乌鸦的火焰更快，紧随其后，将她彻底吞没。

两声几乎同时响起的爆裂声后，白云法宝化作一团残渣坠落在地。

山坳中，韩榆微微皱眉：“是化神信物？”

“打得这么容易……”

“本体没来。”大乌鸦落回韩榆肩头，声音中带着几分遗憾，“他们本体应该正在往四洲小天地逃窜，只派了信物来收尾。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After moving, Han Yu, Wangyou Sanren, Big Crow and Black Dragon King adjusted their direction and quietly arrived at a mountain col ten miles outside Jinxia Temple.

The two of them were like animals, with not even a trace of mana fluctuations escaping, as if they were just a stubborn stone hidden in the crevices of the mountains, waiting quietly.

The mountain gate of Jinxia Temple has been opened, and there are still traces of the broken mountain guarding formation. Several broken formation flags are hanging on both sides of the mountain gate, like snakes with broken spines.

There were vague figures shaking in the view, they were several monks wearing the costumes of Jade Palace and Ziyunzhou.

Not long after, a white cloud magic weapon suddenly appeared in the sky, speeding from a distance.

On top of the Baiyun magic weapon, two figures stood vaguely, one purple and one green, exactly like the ancestors of Ziyun and Liuzhou.

The white cloud magic weapon reached the sky above Jinxia Temple and slowly descended.

At the moment less than a hundred feet away from the mountain gate——

A ball of blazing white flame flew out from Han Yu's shoulder, turned into a firebird with a wingspan of ten feet, and flew straight towards the Liuzhou ancestor on the white cloud magic weapon.

Liuzhou Patriarch's expression changed, and he sent out a stream of black water to meet the flames.

But the black water flow didn't even hold a breath in front of the flames. As soon as it came into contact with the flames, it melted like ice and snow meeting the scorching sun.

The flames continued unabated and directly hit the Baiyun magic weapon.

boom--!

The white cloud magic weapon was shaken violently by the flames, and the auspicious cloud patterns on the surface of the magic weapon were instantly burned and distorted.

Immediately afterwards, the sound of Wangyou Sanren's flute sounded.

It is no longer the probing and pulling in the previous battle, the sound of the flute is directly a killing move.

Layers of sound waves poured down the ground like mercury, penetrating into every hole and heading straight towards the white cloud magic weapon.Every sound wave carries ripples that are visible to the naked eye. Wherever the ripples pass, the air seems to be twisted into twists.

As the flames and sound waves arrived one after another, the two figures on the magic weapon resisted with all their strength, but they could only last for one breath, and then began to become transparent and blurry.

Finally, the sound of the flute passed by, and the figure of "Ancestor Ziyun" was cut open from head to toe, turned into purple light and expanded, but at the moment when it was about to explode, it was wrapped in the flames of the big crow and burned up.

"Liuzhou Ancestor" still wanted to escape, and her body turned into a black light and threw it into Jinxia Temple - but the flames of the big crow were faster, following closely behind, completely engulfing her.

After two explosions sounded almost simultaneously, the Baiyun magic weapon turned into a ball of debris and fell to the ground.

In the mountain col, Han Yu frowned slightly: "Is it a token of the gods?"

"It's so easy to fight..."

"The main body is not here." The big crow landed on Han Yu's shoulder, with a hint of regret in his voice, "The main body should be fleeing to the four continents, and they only sent tokens to finish them off."
